newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Pressure on Belgian franc "ridiculous" - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Pressure on Belgian franc "ridiculous" - central bank.

text.p: The recent weakness of the Belgian franc is "ridiculous", Belgian central bank governor Alfons Verplaetse told financial daily L'Echo.
The paper's Friday edition quoted Verplaetse as saying that the Belgian franc was "in good health" and that its recent weakening against the mark was "derisory".

The Belgian franc weakened to just below its 20.6255 ERM central rate against the mark at the end of January, hitting a two year low, because of worries a series of bribery scandals could destabilise the Belgian government.
Friday in early trade the mark was at 20.6315/25 francs, still below the central rate.
